title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The first chart below shows how energy is used in an average Australian household. The second chart shows the greenhouse gas emissions which result from this energy use.
scenario: Two pie charts compare Australian household energy use with the greenhouse gas emissions which result from this energy use.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
